crossRefs.note: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.
Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name, I cut them off.
who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…
I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,
But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
“You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…

translations.web: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
translations.bsb: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
translations.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
translations.asv: Mine enemies would swallow me up all the day long; For they are many that fight proudly against me.
